bot_config {"Rand": 1}

join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!conch
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!helix
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!helix
send hortbot #foobar [HB] I can provide no help for your situation.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!helix
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Signs point to yes.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!helix
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!helix
send_any


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a test."
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "This is a test." added as quote #1.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!helix
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Maybe these words of wisdom can guide you: "This is a test."
